positioning.basis: absent from a register that downloaded successfully, so no disclosed net short position at or above the 0.5% public threshold. A real zero -- but the threshold truncates, so 0.4% and 0.0% are both recorded here as 0.0, and the join is on the issuer NAME, so a name spelled differently in the register reads as a zero it should not.

expected_move.basis: the larger of (a) the median of this name's prior reactions and (b) a one-session move implied by 20-day realised volatility. It is NOT an option-implied move: nothing is paying for it and it carries no information about what the market expects from THIS print. It is a scale for how far this name travels. Phase 1 median realised move was 2.81% (UK), 3.12% (DE), 4.19% (FR) against Japan's 2.87%, with the tail intact in all three -- 42%, 27% and 52% maxima and no price limit to truncate them.

baseline.priced_lean_basis: Sum of the components above. Read eu_priced_in.lean_components(): every weight is a PRIOR borrowed from the US runs, none is measured on European data, and eu_resolve.py ranks each component separately so measurement can replace them. What matters is only that this is no longer identical to -0.05 * run_up_20d_pct, so the free control is a real rival again.

evidence.text: The company's own Q3 booking guide (79% of 1,304 fleet days at $113,681/day, Suezmax at $130,239) implies Q3 EPS of about $0.87 (NOK 8.1 at the September USD/NOK of 9.3), even if the open 21% earned only the booked rate. That is about 10% above the single Yahoo estimate of NOK 7.36.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 beat Yahoo's estimate by 47% and the stock moved -0.63%; Q2 matched and it moved -1.39% (baseline history, observed NewsWeb dates). Beats have not been bought, on n=2.
evidence.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the guide is public and anyone modelling the name can derive this. What remains unpriced is only the gap to a single stale Yahoo estimate. If the market had held a higher bar, that estimate would have been revised up more than 0.5% since the guide; it moved 7.32 to 7.36. Sized near zero because it lands inside what the company guided.
evidence.independence: Q3 operating cash generation looks strong: per the main-list prospectus, cash at 30 Sep 2026 ($356.3m) was flat on 30 Jun ($356.7m) despite a $43.3m dividend and three deliveries (https://www.capitaltankers.com/files/pdf/CAPITAL_TANKERS_CORP_Prospectus.pdf). Debt also rose $175m, so this is weak.

evidence.text: The Q4-to-date booking update should be a record and far above the stale Yahoo Q4 EPS of NOK 5.73 (range 3.53-7.94), which sits BELOW the Q3 estimate. Frontline's 20 Nov release shows Q4 contracted Suezmax spot at $324,300/day (69%) and LR2/Aframax at $190,800 (68%), against Q3 achieved of $102,500 and $67,800. CAPT's fleet is 8 Suezmax and 8 Aframax/LR2.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: CAPT's Q2 booking update (Q3 79% at $113.7k, about flat on Q2's $116.3k) was met with -1.39%. Peers' Q4 booking disclosures this month: Okeanis (11 Nov, after close) -1.9% the next session, Frontline (20 Nov, bmo) +2.1%, Hafnia (18 Nov) -2.7%.
evidence.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the sector's Q4 rates are public through peers, and CAPT rose 6.6% in the five sessions after Frontline's release. What is not priced is the CAPT-specific number on thin coverage (3 analysts, $3.8m/day of turnover). The Yahoo Q4 estimate implies earnings falling quarter on quarter, and the stock trades at NOK 175 against targets of NOK 226-290. If the market held a Q4 near 2x Q3, the estimates would show it. Cut for proxy transmission (peer to company), for discharge-to-discharge accounting that will print below Frontline's headline, and for the November correction weighing on the open ~30% of days.
evidence.independence: Okeanis Q3 release (11 Nov): Q4 Suezmax 60% booked at $410,900/day, VLCC spot 48% at $688,800 (https://finviz.com/news/421240/okeanis-eco-tankers-corp-unaudited-condensed-financial-results-for-the-third-quarter-and-nine-month-period-of-2026). CAPT's own M/T Amor 15-month charter at about $160-180k/day (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=685839).

evidence.text: Rates corrected sharply in early November. Kpler (6 Nov) measured Suezmax WAF-UKC down 40% in a week ($18.27 to $11.01/bbl) and Aframax USG-UKC from $20.75 to $11.71/bbl. CAPT's own prospectus (24 Nov) says 'More recently, the spot market has softened versus recent highs', so the open Q4 days and the outlook commentary carry downside.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No CAPT print has carried a softening outlook. The sector fell 15-20% from 30 Oct to mid-November on the correction.
evidence.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 20-day -15.4% matches the peers' drop from the 30 Oct peak. What remains is only the chance that management's outlook makes the November softening explicit on the call. Kpler expected rates to level off and rebound, which limits it.
evidence.independence: Prospectus section 10.2, 24 Nov 2026: 'More recently, the spot market has softened versus recent highs' (https://www.capitaltankers.com/files/pdf/CAPITAL_TANKERS_CORP_Prospectus.pdf). Okeanis management said rates 'had corrected from October peaks' (https://quartr.com/events/okeanis-eco-tankers-oet-q3-2026_3sH2c95u, an AI summary, snippet-grade).

evidence.text: The dividend payout is set against $1.46bn of remaining newbuild capex ($948m of it in 2027), which the prospectus says will be funded partly from operating cash flow. A Q3 payout near the Q2 ~46% (vs 90-100% at Frontline and Okeanis) is the likely outcome, which leaves the dividend line no better than neutral.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's step-up from NOK 0.50 to 3.00 was announced alongside a -1.39% day.
evidence.why_not_priced: The payout policy is only 'a portion of Ordinary Net Income' (prospectus section 5.1), so the level is genuinely new on the day. The size is small because a payout around half is what the Q1-Q2 trend already shows.
evidence.independence: Frontline paid out 100% of adjusted EPS ($2.38/share) and Okeanis $7.00 on $7.67 for Q3 (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=687036 ; https://finviz.com/news/421240/okeanis-eco-tankers-corp-unaudited-condensed-financial-results-for-the-third-quarter-and-nine-month-period-of-2026).

first_hunter_context.session_check: bmo. The 6 Nov RNS names 30 November 2026 as the interims date, and every EAH results RNS on record was released at 07:00 London (1 Dec 2025, 15 Jul 2026), so this is a convention and not a timestamp for 30 Nov: https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/EAH

evidence.text: China's national DLY live hog price fell to a new cycle low of CNY 8.60/kg on 6 Nov 2026, below April's 8.67. Mysteel expects sideways-to-lower prices through December. This cuts against the Board's 6 Nov assumption that China revenue improves in H2, which the reiterated full-year EBITDA guide depends on: H2 must make c.£5.5m EBITDA, flat on H2 FY26, with China down by roughly half.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: China-driven guidance cuts have hit this stock hard: -21.65% on the 1 Oct 2024 trading update and -12.1% on the 6 Nov 2026 update
evidence.why_not_priced: The 6 Nov RNS used MARA wholesale pork prices only to 1 Nov and framed them as recovering from the June low. The live-hog new low came after the RNS. If the market had fully priced a China H2 miss, the shares would trade near an EBITDA-cut valuation. The 8.4% post-update drift is consistent with partial pricing, which is why this is sized small. It is macro-to-company transmission, and the company has not said it.
evidence.independence: Trading Economics' November 2026 China food CPI update has pork still -10% y/y (https://tradingeconomics.com/china/food-inflation/news/599316, search snippet only). The company's own week-to-1-Nov wholesale figure, -13.8% y/y and 6% below the September peak, is in the 6 Nov RNS.

evidence.text: Since absorbing the 6 Nov warning (83.5p close), the shares have slid to 76.45p (-8.4%) on thin volume. The only RNS since were two positives: the ECOVAXXIN MG EU filing and the Aivlosin Saudi/Oman sales start. A reiteration of the 6 Nov EBITDA/EPS guide on 30 Nov therefore lands on a lower price than the one that priced it.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interims that followed a China warning rose: +9.16% on 28 Nov 2024 after the -21.65% warning of 1 Oct 2024; last year's interims +4.26% (1 Dec 2025)
evidence.why_not_priced: A reiteration is what the company already guided, so this is sized near zero. The only thing not priced is that the price fell after the guide without any new company-level news. Had the market believed the guide, the shares would have held around 83p.
evidence.independence: The precedent comes from the baseline's observed RNS reaction history (https://www.investegate.co.uk/company/EAH). No different source points the same way.

evidence.text: Soros Fund Management, the largest disclosed hedge-fund holder, cut its stake from 9.77% to 8.97% (6.08m shares) on 7 Oct 2026. It may still be selling into any results-day bounce; its next TR-1 threshold is 8%.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this name
evidence.why_not_priced: Public for seven weeks and partly in the post-warning drift. Whether the seller is finished is unknown; a further TR-1 below 8% would say so. Small.
evidence.independence: Volume of 1.9m and 1.1m shares on 6-7 Oct against a typical 50-100k (Yahoo tape).

evidence.text: PRRSvmAb proof-of-concept trial 'completing in the near term', with an indicative £0-100m valuation range against a ~£52m market cap. A readout would move the stock a lot, but nothing dates it inside the 30 Nov window
